channel.title: Rick Chow — Journal
channel.description: Rick Chow is a software engineer and game developer exploring how AI, simulation and production tools can help small teams build ambitious playable worlds.

item.title: From 2D concept to a playable 3D character in Unity
item.description: A practical AI-assisted pipeline for turning a character idea into a textured, rigged and animated Unity-ready model.

item.title: Building a voxel game asset in MagicaVoxel and Unity
item.description: How I turn a visual reference into modular voxel art, export it cleanly and assemble a playable scene in Unity.

item.title: Click-to-move in Unity: moving a character along the mouse path
item.description: A practical Unity raycast pattern for moving a character to the point a player clicks, with an explanation of mouse picking and a cleaned-up, Unity 6-ready script.

item.title: 在 Unity 製作點擊移動：讓角色沿滑鼠路徑移動
item.description: 以 Raycast 取得地面座標，製作點擊移動的角色控制；附滑鼠選取原理解說，以及整理過、適用於 Unity 6 的程式碼。

item.title: After Effects 製作旅行 VLOG 地圖路線動畫
item.description: 以 After Effects 的 3D 圖層、攝影機和 Null 物件，為旅行 VLOG 製作地圖路線動畫的製作筆記。

item.title: Maya modelling study: a Dieffenbachia potted plant
item.description: A five-hour Maya modelling study of a Dieffenbachia Tropic Snow: a primitive pot, low-poly leaf planes and a variegated leaf texture.

item.title: Unity – 以 Blend Tree 製作八方向 2D 角色
item.description: 以 Unity 的 2D Freeform Cartesian Blend Tree，為 Ragnarok Online 風格的 2D 角色設定八個方向的行走動畫。

item.title: Maya Logo Animation (Alto Studio)
item.description: An early twenty-second logo animation exercise made while learning Maya, and what a logo reveal teaches about timing.

item.title: What does game design mean to me?
item.description: An early reflection (2010) on game design, learning and the relationship between play and everyday life.

item.title: 淺談網絡科技與網頁製作
item.description: 2010 年的網頁製作筆記：Google 的崛起、Photoshop 切片，以及以 div 和 CSS 排版的早期做法。

item.title: Teaching RPG enemies to learn from the player — a 2007 neural-network prototype
item.description: A retrospective on my 2007 final-year project: a C++ and DirectX action RPG that explored online neural-network learning for adaptive NPC behaviour — with a ground-up explanation of how the network worked.
